record.question: Section 483. (1) states that, Before conclusion of the trial and before disposal of the appeal, the Court trying the offence or the Appellate Court, as the case may be, shall require the accused to execute bond or bail bond, to appear before the higher Court as and when such Court issues notice in respect of any appeal or petition filed against the judgment of the respective Court and such bond shall be in force for _________.
record.explanation: The printed Q36 (p.6) refers to the bond under Section 483(1) BNSS, which remains in force for six months, the period used in the corresponding CrPC provision (Section 437A). The option 'six months.' is the match.
